poema.texto:
Title: Zéjel (Simbolismo)

In the silence of my heart's recess, (a)
A symbol blooms with secrets unpossessed. (a)

The moonlight whispers on its petals, (b)
Unveiling dreams that in daytime are hidden. (b)

A dance of shadows, a waltz of shades, (b)
In the mirror of my soul they have played. (b)

Poetry, the echo of my inner flight, (c)
Reflects the unseen, illuminates the night. (c)

The symbol speaks, in verses it unfolds, (c)
The truth hidden within the poet's soul. (c)

Simbolismo, the language of dreams, (c)
In my verses, a reality it seems. (c)

Thus, the symbolism of poetry sings, (c)
In every verse, a heart's unspoken things. (c)
